[LG CordZero T9] Why are there marks on the product exterior?
This product does not use spray coating processes that release environmentally harmful substances.
Instead, aluminum powder is added during exterior manufacturing to create a premium sheen directly in the material.
The patterns shown below do not affect the product's durability or performance.
Because there is no coating to peel off from external impacts, the product will maintain a clean appearance longer than coated products.

Increases carbon dioxide emissions.
For these reasons, the LG CordZero T9 does not use spray coating.

[LG CordZero A9] How do I install the exhaust filter?
If you look closely at the vacuum, you will see circular marks on the exhaust filter and the handle.
Use the circle marks as a guide to align and install the exhaust filter correctly.
Align the circle on the exhaust filter with the circle on the handle.
Turn the exhaust filter clockwise until the mark aligns with the black circle.
Always ensure the exhaust filter and pre-filter are installed before use.
